products.title: Antioxidant Conditioner - Apiceuticals

variants.description:
PROPOWAX™ SERIES
ANTIOXIDANT • ANTIPOLLUTION

100% Clean, Sustainable, Cruelty-free Beauty
10.1 fl. oz. / 300 ml

The PROPOWAX™ Antioxidant Conditioner nourishes, detangles, and restores hair while soothing and balancing the scalp. Powered by the patented Living Honeycomb, proven to deliver the highest antioxidant activity worldwide, this formula protects against oxidative stress while moisturizing and smoothing split ends. Leaves hair silky, frizz-free, and enveloped in Apiceuticals’ signature ultra-luxury fragrance.

How to Use: After cleansing (preferably with Antioxidant Shampoo PROPOWAX™ Series), apply a small amount to scalp and hair. Massage gently to allow antioxidants and oils to penetrate. Leave it for 3-5 mins. Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water. For a spa-like ritual, follow with Antioxidant Dry Oil PROPOWAX™ Series.

Ingredients and Safety: Aqua (Water), Cetearyl Alcohol, Behentrimonium Chloride, Betaine, Glycerin, Olea Europaea (Olive) Fruit Oil, Honey/mel, Melissa Officinalis Flower Extract, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Propolis Cera, Propolis Extract, Beeswax (Cera alba), Chamomilla Recutita (Chamomile) Flower Extract, Crambe Abyssinica Seed Oil, Passiflora Edulis Seed Oil, Phytosterols, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Extract, Sodium Gluconate, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate, Sodium Levulinate, Oleyl Alcohol, Isopropyl Alcohol, Parfum (Fragrance), Hexyl Cinnamal.

details_sections.heading: Golden Ingredients
details_sections.body:
Patented PROPOWAX™ LIVING HONEYCOMB
Powerful Antioxidant Activity

A revolutionary technology where a real honeycomb is encapsulated within the formula. It continuously releases antioxidants during use, repairing oxidative damage and protecting against pollution, UV, and stress. It restores scalp balance and strengthens hair at its roots.

ORGANIC HONEY
Moisture & Shine

Rich in amino acids, vitamins, and minerals, it deeply seals hydration, smooths hair cuticle, prevents breakage, and adds luminous shine.

ORGANIC BEE PROPOLIS
Scalp Defense

A natural shield with antiviral, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory powers. It ensures scalp hygiene, regulates sebum, calms irritation, and prevents hair from becoming greasy too quickly.

VIRGIN MARACUJA OIL
Regenerative Boost

Rich in omega-3, omega-6, and vitamins A, E, F. Strengthens hair strands, reduces split ends, and nourishes scalp.

CHAMOMILE OIL
Anti-Dandruff Soother

Calms dry scalp, prevents flaking, and restores oil balance.

VIRGIN OLIVE OIL
Frizz Control & Moisture

Deeply hydrates and smooths rough ends, leaving hair glossy and soft.

ABYSSUNIAN OIL
Split End Eliminator

Nourishes deeply, reduces tangling, and repairs damage, preventing new split ends.

VIEW INCI LIST

details_sections.heading: FAQ
details_sections.body:
Is it free of SLS/SLES, Parabens, Silicones?

YES. Apiceuticals Clean Beauty excludes over 2,000 harmful ingredients. Strictly dermatologically tested with 0% irritation cases.

Is the honeycomb inside real?

Yes – the patented PROPOWAX™ Living Honeycomb is real and encapsulated within the formula. It continuously infuses antioxidants into the conditioner, scalp, and hair.

Why are antioxidants important for haircare?

Pollution, UV, and styling create free radicals that damage scalp cells and weaken hair. Antioxidants neutralize this damage, preserving scalp health and giving hair strength, resilience, and shine.

Is it suitable for oily, dry, colored, or fine hair?

Yes – due to its adaptogenic antioxidant activity, the conditioner adjusts to each need: balancing excess sebum, hydrating dryness, protecting color-treated strands, and adding strength and volume to fine or thinning hair.

How does it smell?

WOODS OF ARCADIA
Apiceuticals' Signature Scent

– an ultra-luxury, fine fragrance created for haute perfumery.

Experience a true utopia of bliss with a spicy base from vanilla and sandalwood, rising through a sensual heart of cedarwood and blackberry, and finishing with heavenly top notes of citrus and pink pepper.

This is “Woods of Arcadia” – soft, golden, and quietly powerful – an olfactory signature of elegance, nature, and timeless luxury.

Fragrance Key Pyramid Notes:
Top: Citrus Notes, Pink Pepper, Cardamom
Middle: Apricot, Blackberry, Cedarwood
Base: Vanilla, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Agarwood
